name: vc_chatterbox
description: Chatterbox voice conversion: the uploaded speech (`input`, the audio of a clip) re-voiced with the timbre of `target_voice` (the character's locked reference, 5-10 s), timing kept. Saved as flac by core SaveAudio and returned under the `audio` key by the repo's patched worker handler. The node downloads ResembleAI/chatterbox s3gen.pt + conds.pt into models/chatterbox/chatterbox_vc/ at first use if they are not on the volume.

files.target_voice: the character's locked voice reference (wav, 5-10 s)
